name: games
description: games.homectl.no — a PWA hosting several small games, one code-split chunk each

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @games/shared run build && pnpm --filter @games/backend run build && pnpm --filter @games/frontend run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @games/shared run test && pnpm --filter @games/backend run test && pnpm --filter @games/frontend run test:unit

pnpm.// onlyBuiltDependencies: pnpm 10 blocks install scripts by default. esbuild is the only dependency that needs one; the rest (native speedups behind testcontainers) work fine without.
